texts.zh:
我们的[owner.GetScientistPlural]研究后得知，这位客人扭曲触手的动作其实是一种复杂的语言形式。

于是乎我们沮丧地了解到这个生物正因为衣不蔽体而感到尴尬，正在反复地请求合适的衣物以遮蔽其赤裸的躯体。

在得体地遮蔽躯体后，我们的研究者建造了一台多肢机器以便与这个生物交流。
texts.en:
Our [owner.GetScientistPlural] has determined the wriggling tentacle motions of our guest are a form of sophisticated sign language.

To our dismay, we thus learned that the creature is embarrassed about its lack of clothing and has been repeatedly asking for appropriate garments to cover its naked appendages.

After it's suitably clad, our researchers have proposed the construction of a many-tentacled machine to better aid communication with the creature.

notes.zh: 起点：fircon.1200（隐藏，五年脉冲池权重5，每局一次，需First Contact DLC）创建“万爪之母”虚拟国家并启动首次接触。
notes.en: Start: fircon.1200 (hidden; five-year pulse pool weight 5, once per country, needs the First Contact DLC) creates the Many-Tentacled One dummy country and starts the first-contact procedure.

texts.zh:
我们的这位访客十分健谈，但文化差异让我们难以相互理解。现在我们知道了该生物为雌性，她称自己为“万爪之母”，似乎隶属于某个它称之为薄幕行者的唯心主义教团。但我们仍然不明白这个她一直唠唠叨叨不停的“山现”是什么，或者它和她的突然出现之间有什么因果关系。

我们继续尝试同其进行沟通。
texts.en:
Our guest is very talkative, but cultural differences are making it hard for us to understand each other. We now know that the creature is female, refers to herself as "The Many-Tentacled One" and seems to be a member of a spiritual order it calls the Veilfarers. But we still don't understand what this 'Jaunt' She keeps mentioning is, or how it can be responsible for her sudden appearance.

Our communication efforts continue.

texts.zh:
我们的研究人员终于拼凑出了“万爪之母”的故事：我们的宾客是一位专注于研究闪现的唯心主义教团的领袖：这是一种允许在宇宙中任何地方瞬间传送的灵能技术。纵观她的物种的历史，从来没有人成功地进行过闪现……直到现在。

万爪之母不确定她是否有能力复制这一壮举，更何况她的能量储备目前已经耗尽，无法再做尝试。

当前，她愿意继续接受我们的照顾，并将通过帮助我们的研究人员来回报我们的热情款待。
texts.en:
Our researchers have finally pieced together the Many-Tentacled One's story: our guest is the head of a spiritual order focused on studying the Jaunt: a psionic technique that allows for instantaneous teleportation anywhere in the universe. Throughout the history of her species, no one has ever managed to perform a successful Jaunt... Until now.

The Many-Tentacled One is unsure about her ability to replicate the feat, and her energy reserves are currently too depleted to make another attempt.

For now, she would like to remain in our care, and will repay our hospitality by aiding our researchers.

label.en: We'll welcome her as an equal.

tooltips.zh: 万爪之母将作为一名科学家加入我们。
tooltips.en: The Many-Tentacled One joins our ranks as a scientist.

label.zh: 和平结局：加入为科学家（60+随机30天）
label.en: Pacific ending: she joins as a scientist (60 days + random 30)
We'll welcome her as an equal.

label.zh: 她可以留在这，但不会很自由。
label.en: She can stay. But she won't be free.

label.zh: 她可以留下，送到活体解剖实验室去。
label.en: She can stay. In our vivisection labs.

label.zh: 这恶心玩意儿怎么能留在我们的星球上！
label.en: This abomination has no place in our world!

notes.zh: 三个结局：和平（创造通灵科学家领袖）、实验室（研究点）、牺牲（团结点，仅排外/军国/死亡崇拜者）；实验室需唯物主义或非亲外或技术官僚。
notes.en: Three endings: pacific (a psionic scientist leader), lab (research), sacrifice (unity; only xenophobe/militarist/death-cult empires); the lab option needs materialist, non-xenophile or technocracy.

texts.zh:
我们的[owner.GetScientistPlural]表示有兴趣学习闪现，即万爪之母用来抵达我们母星的传送技术。

这位笼罩着神秘主义色彩的太空生命愿意分享她的知识，尽管她也不确定我们是否能够复制这项技术。我们首都的一座合适的建筑已经准备好被改造成一座研究用的神殿。
texts.en:
Our [owner.GetScientistPlural] have expressed an interest in learning the Jaunt, the teleportation technique used by the Many-Tentacled One to reach our homeworld.

The space-faring mystic is willing to share her knowledge, though she doubts we will be able to replicate the technique. A suitable building in our capital is ready to be converted into a temple facility for research purposes.

texts.zh:
新的数据表明我们的[owner.GetScientistPlural]或许有能力学习闪现，即万爪之母用来抵达我们母星的传送技术。

这位笼罩着神秘主义色彩的太空生命愿意分享她的知识，尽管她也不确定我们是否能够复制这项技术。我们首都的一座合适的建筑已经准备好被改造成一座研究用的神殿。
texts.en:
New data suggests that our [owner.GetScientistPlural] may be capable of learning the Jaunt, the teleportation technique used by the Many-Tentacled One to reach our homeworld.

The space-faring mystic is willing to share her knowledge, though she doubts we will be able to replicate the technique. A suitable building in our capital is ready to be converted into a temple facility for research purposes.

texts.zh: 万爪之母在我们首都的凭空出现证明了“灵能传送”这一曾经只存在于理论层面的概念是实操上可行的。通过让我们最能干的[owner.GetScientistPlural]投入研究工作，也许就可以学会这种瞬间旅行方式的秘密。
texts.en: The sudden appearance of the Many-Tentacled One on our capital has proven that the once theoretical concept of 'psionic teleportation' is workable in practice. By putting our most effective [owner.GetScientistPlural] on the job, it might be possible for us to learn the secrets of instantaneous interstellar travel.

texts.zh:
我们的[owner.GetScientistPlural]花费了数不尽的时间试图掌握灵能传送的秘密，终于，其中的一位成功地进行了闪现！

这位研究人员传送了一米，但因为传送至地板内导致失去了下部附肢。随之而来的是许多掌声和一些尖叫声。
texts.en:
After spending many years trying to master the secrets of psionic teleportation, one of our [owner.GetScientistPlural] finally managed to Jaunt successfully.

The researcher teleported a short distance but lost their lower appendages as a result of partly teleporting inside a floor. Much clapping and some screaming ensued.

texts.zh:
我们的[owner.GetScientistPlural]花费了数不尽的时间试图掌握灵能传送的秘密，终于，其中的一位成功地进行了闪现！

这位研究人员传送了一米，但因为传送至地板内导致失去了一些关键部件。
texts.en:
After spending many years trying to master the secrets of psionic teleportation, one of our [owner.GetScientistPlural] finally managed to Jaunt successfully.

The researcher teleported a short distance but lost some key components as a result of partly teleporting inside a floor.

texts.zh:
又一次成功闪现了！根据我们的传感器数据，我们的一位[owner.GetScientistPlural]成功地传送到了离我们最近的恒星系，在几分之一秒内跨越了不可估量的距离。只是这个倒霉蛋在一颗恒星内实体化，并瞬间化为灰烬。

使用这种技术来推进舰船讨论遭到了深刻的质疑。虽然建造灵能的推进的引擎存在可能性，但这种技术应用起来可能会难以置信地危险，甚至会给宇宙带来混乱。
texts.en:
Another successful Jaunt. According to our sensor data, one of our [owner.GetScientistPlural] managed to teleport to our closest neighboring solar system, crossing incalculable distances in a fraction of a second... Only to materialize inside a star and become instantly incinerated.

Talks of using this technique to propel ships have been met with profound skepticism. While the construction of a psionic propulsion drive might be possible, such technology could be incredibly dangerous to use and may bring chaos to the galaxy.

texts.zh:
又一次成功闪现了！根据我们的传感器数据，我们的一位[owner.GetScientistPlural]成功地传送到了离我们最近的恒星系，在几分之一秒内跨越了不可估量的距离。只是这个倒霉蛋在一颗恒星内实体化，并瞬间化为灰烬。

目前，使用这种技术来推进舰船的前景还停留在理论阶段。虽然建造灵能的推进的引擎存在可能性，但这种技术应用起来可能会难以置信地危险，甚至会给宇宙带来混乱。
texts.en:
Another successful Jaunt. According to our sensor data, one of our [owner.GetScientistPlural] managed to teleport to our closest neighboring solar system, crossing incalculable distances in a fraction of a second... Only to materialize inside a star and become instantly incinerated.

The prospect of using this technique to propel ships remains purely theoretical for now. While the construction of a psionic propulsion drive might be possible, such technology could be incredibly dangerous to use and may bring chaos to the galaxy.

texts.zh: 我们在完善闪现之后得到的结论是：一无是处。我们的[GetResearchers]们可能要花费数十年来掌握这项技术，结果也只会是因传送入石头、恒星甚至是一颗黑洞的首次闪现而死。它实在太不精确，根本带不来任何可行的好处。我们越是尝试，就越清楚地意识到，万爪之母的到来完全是随缘。
texts.en: Here is what we learned after perfecting the Jaunt: it's useless. Our [GetResearchers] could spend decades learning to master the technique, only to die on the first Jaunt when they materialize inside a rock, a star, or even a black hole. It is too imprecise to provide any workable benefits. The more we try to Jaunt, the clearer it becomes that the arrival of the Many-Tentacled One was entirely random.

Our [GetResearchers] could spend decades learning to master the technique, only to die on the first Jaunt when they materialize inside a rock, a star, or even a black hole. It is too imprecise to provide any workable benefits. The more we try to Jaunt, the clearer it becomes that the arrival of the Many-Tentacled One was entirely random.

It is too imprecise to provide any workable benefits. The more we try to Jaunt, the clearer it becomes that the arrival of the Many-Tentacled One was entirely random.

texts.zh: 尽管如此，我们获得的知识也会有一些工程应用。
texts.en: Nonetheless, the knowledge we gained will have some engineering applications.

texts.zh: 然而，通过通过将闪现的原理应用到飞船工程而不是单个躯体之中，我们的[GetResearchers]距离造出灵能跃迁引擎仅有一步之遥，将灵能传送变成了一个更可靠、更安全的手段。
texts.en: However, by applying the principles of the Jaunt to ship engineering rather than individual bodies, our [GetResearchers] are one step closer to building a Psi Jump Drives and turning psionic teleportation into a more reliable, marginally safer endeavor.

也许总有一天，我们梦寐以求的灵能推进器会成为现实。但至少不是今天。

Here is what we learned after perfecting the Jaunt: it's useless. Our [GetResearchers] could spend decades learning to master the technique, only to die on the first Jaunt when they materialize inside a rock, a star, or even a black hole. It is too imprecise to provide any workable benefits. The more we try to Jaunt, the clearer it becomes that the arrival of the Many-Tentacled One was entirely random.

One day, perhaps, the psionic propulsion drive we desire will become reality. But not today.

tooltips.en: Psi Jump Drive technology now appears at 1.5 times the normal rate.

texts.zh:
我们的万爪之母最近表达了回归家乡的渴望，但我们难以定位她的母星系：她所描述的天体特征不符合我们所知星系的任何一个区域。

我们的访客凝视着夜空，久久不曾挪开视线。
texts.en:
Our Many-Tentacled One has recently expressed a desire to return to her people, but our efforts to locate her home system have proven fruitless: the celestial features she described don't correspond to any known part of the galaxy.

Our guest's gaze remains fixed on the night sky.

label.zh: 再加把劲。我们会找到她的家乡的！
label.en: Redouble our efforts. We'll find her home!

label.zh: 我们这不就是她的家吗。

texts.zh:
万爪之母无处可寻。这个生物突然地出现，现在却又突然地消失了，仅仅在研究设施的地板上留下了一条匆忙划下的告别信息。

“我很害怕，但我必须要闪现离开了。我心中的思乡之情无处排解，苦痛难耐。感谢你们所做的一切。我祈祷薄幕会善待我。”
texts.en:
The Many-Tentacled One is nowhere to be found. The creature disappeared as abruptly as she appeared, leaving a hastily scratched goodbye message on the floor of the research facility:

'I'm scared, but I have to Jaunt. My hearts ache with thoughts of home. Thank you for everything. I pray the Veil will be kind to me.'

tooltips.en: The The Many-Tentacled One has left.

texts.zh: 我们的一艘舰船截获了一个突然凭空出现在我们母星系的储藏箱。在我们的物种一接触到它的瞬间，上面复杂的锁就自动解开了，展露出了其中令人瞠目咋舌的大量工艺品……还有一张来自多肢旅行者的感谢纸条，其中声称她在几十年前曾经造访过我们的母星。
texts.en: One of our ships has intercepted a cache that suddenly materialized in our home system. The complex lock gave way as soon as a member of our species touched it, revealing a dizzying collection of artifacts... And a thank-you note from a Many-Tentacled traveler who claims to have visited our home planet decades ago.

texts.zh:
我们没能成功地给这位神秘访客提供合适的营养：该生物很快就生病了，它拒绝餐食，还拒绝作出任何应答。

在我们能够进一步了解它的新陈代谢机制之前，通讯行为暂时停止。
texts.en:
Our attempts to provide our mysterious visitor with suitable nourishment have failed: the creature quickly sickened, expelled the meal, and is currently unresponsive.

Communication efforts are on hold until we can gain a better understanding of its metabolism.

texts.zh:
该生物对我们的尝试性联络反应激烈，猛烈地袭击了一位我们的科学家，并拒绝进一步的合作。也许我们无意见冒犯了它。

尽管没有人严重受伤，但是这次事故依然对迄今为止我们同这个生物建立的脆弱的信任造成了损伤。
texts.en:
The creature has reacted violently to our communication attempts, lashing out at one of our scientists and refusing further collaboration. We believe we have unintentionally offended it.

While no one was seriously injured, the accident has damaged the fragile trust we have so far built up with the creature.

# 万爪之母 / The Many-Tentacled One

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7)

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 隐藏事件 fircon.1200 在五年脉冲池中权重为5；需 First Contact DLC，每个帝国一次（jaunting_traveler_chain）。它创建虚拟国家“万爪之母”并自动启动首次接触，三个阶段按普通首次接触的检定推进。
  Hidden event fircon.1200 sits in the five-year pulse pool with weight 5; needs the First Contact DLC, once per country (jaunting_traveler_chain). It creates the "Many-Tentacled One" dummy country and starts a first-contact procedure with three stages.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 阶段1（难度3）1210「建立联络」→ 阶段2（难度2）1211「万爪之母」→ 最终阶段（难度3）1212「迷失旅行者」。
  Stage 1 (difficulty 3) 1210 "Communication Established" -> stage 2 (difficulty 2) 1211 "The Many-Tentacled One" -> final stage (difficulty 3) 1212 "Lost Traveler".
- 任一阶段检定失败时，有1/20的机会触发随机事件（之后125天冷却）：1220「食物中毒」或 1221「外交事故」（权重各1，各至多一次）。
  A failed roll in any stage has a 1-in-20 chance of a random event (then a 125-day cooldown): 1220 "Food Poisoning" or 1221 "Diplomatic Accident" (weight 1 each, each at most once).
- 1212 三个结局：和平（她成为通灵科学家领袖；60+随机30天后 1230，1800+随机360天后思乡事件 1231）；实验室（社会研究奖励）；牺牲（团结奖励）。
  1212 has three endings: pacific (she becomes a psionic scientist leader; 1230 after 60 days + random 30, homesickness 1231 after 1800 + random 360); lab (society research); sacrifice (unity).
- 1230（非排外且主种族通灵）可启用 THE_JAUNT_PROJECT（1080天）：进度25%→1240、75%→1241；完成后 10% → 1243「成功」（获得跃迁引擎科技进度/研究），90% → 1242「失败」（工程研究，设“秘密已揭示”标志）。
  1230 (non-xenophobe, psionic main species) can enable THE_JAUNT_PROJECT (1080 days): 25% -> 1240, 75% -> 1241; on completion 10% -> 1243 "success" (Psi Jump Drive progress or research), 90% -> 1242 "failure" (engineering research, sets the secret-revealed flag).
- 1231「思乡」：关心她则10年后 1232「告别」，否则5年后；告别后有20%概率在20年后收到礼物 1233。
  1231 "Homesickness": showing concern keeps her 10 years before 1232 "Goodbye", otherwise 5; after goodbye there is a 20% chance of a gift (1233) 20 years later.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 三个结局互斥；1220/1221 互斥地随机；1242/1243 互斥。
  The three endings are exclusive; 1220/1221 are a random pair; 1242/1243 are exclusive.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 和平结局名称随是否排外而异；机械/集体意识帝国在1230、1240-1243 有不同措辞。
  The pacific option text varies with xenophobia; machine and gestalt empires see different wording in 1230 and 1240-1243.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：`events/first_contact_dlc_events.txt:511-1108`；`common/first_contact/02_first_contact_unique_stories.txt:177-232`；`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:505`；`common/scripted_effects/first_contact_effects.txt:1818-1836`；`common/special_projects/00_projects_first_contact_dlc.txt:286-325`
- 已核对：fircon.1200 触发、三阶段与失败池、1212 选项条件、项目权重、思乡事件延迟。
  Checked: fircon.1200 trigger, the three stages and the failure pool, 1212 option conditions, the project weights, the homesickness delays.
- 更正：1210、1211、1220、1221 原为各自孤立的单窗口故事，1212 只含后半段；现合并成一条首次接触故事。
  Correction: 1210, 1211, 1220, 1221 were isolated one-window stories and 1212 only held the second half; now one first-contact story.
